Bold mid-century-inspired gouache illustration with simplified graphic forms, visible dry-brush pigment, softly imperfect dark-ink contours and a tactile uncoated-paper print feel. Use a rich limited palette of cobalt, tomato red, warm cream and spruce green, with small warm-gold accents, flat painted colour blocks, sparse highlights and crisp blue-hour contrast. Maintain lively adult festive energy, elegant balanced asymmetry, generous breathing room and highly legible typography areas; pair expressive retro display lettering with clean modern sans-serif details.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Bold mid-century-inspired gouache illustration for an adult Christmas party invitation, combining simplified graphic forms with an energetic handcrafted print feel.; line weight: Fine to medium outlines with occasional heavier contour accents.; line quality: Softly imperfect dark-ink contours, dry-brush edges and lightly irregular hand-drawn marks.; detail level: Moderate detail: strong simplified silhouettes and large colour fields, with selective small decorative accents and clearly protected event-information space.; background density: Airy, graphic backgrounds with broad calm areas; decorative detail stays at the edges so wording remains highly legible.; composition: Clear visual hierarchy led by an expressive headline, one strong central illustration and a well-defined event-details block; use generous negative space and balanced asymmetry.; palette: Rich, limited festive palette of cobalt blue, tomato red, warm cream and spruce green, supported by small deep-ink and warm golden accents.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Mostly flat gouache colour blocks with sparse painted highlights, subtle tonal variation and minimal dimensional shading.; texture: Visible dry-brush gouache grain, lightly mottled pigment and a tactile uncoated-paper print character.; mood: Lively, cosy, stylish and celebratory, with an adult winter-party atmosphere..

PAGE 1 of "Alpine Après-Ski Christmas Party Invitation" (invitation): Single-sided landscape Christmas party invitation. Exact headline text: “CHRISTMAS PARTY”. Snowy alpine village at blue hour with a wide mountain lodge silhouette across the lower third, snow-capped roof, glowing warm windows, small flanking spruce trees and snowdrifts. Add one tomato-red and cream striped ski sign pointing inward, exact sign text: “APRÈS SKI”. Place a large uncluttered warm-cream event-details panel beneath the lodge with these exact editable lines: “JOIN US FOR”, “[HOST / VENUE]”, “SATURDAY 14 DECEMBER · 7 PM”, “[ADDRESS]”, “RSVP: [CONTACT]”. Add sparse edge-only snowflakes and tiny stars; protect all wording areas.

CANVAS: A single landscape design with an illustrated background that is part of the artwork. The artwork runs to every edge (full bleed). Keep all text and key elements inside a comfortable inner safe area. It must look like a finished invitation, with clear, well-proportioned space reserved for the event wording. Keep a large calm cream event-details panel centrally beneath the lodge, with all editable wording set in high-contrast type and a clean trim-safe perimeter. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied or recognisable composition, lettering, logo, artwork or branding from existing ski, alpine or Christmas designs; Photorealism, glossy 3D rendering or hyper-detailed realism; Childish cartoon styling or juvenile novelty graphics; Overcrowded layouts, busy texture behind event details or weak information hierarchy; Misspelled text, illegible display lettering or placeholder-like event details; Neon-heavy colour schemes, excessive gradients or metallic effects that reproduce poorly at home.
